욥기 36:2.content: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.

욥기 36:3.content: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

욥기 36:4.content: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

욥기 36:5.content: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

욥기 36:6.content: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

욥기 36:7.content: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

욥기 36:8.content: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

욥기 36:9.content: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

욥기 36:10.content: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

욥기 36:11.content: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

욥기 36:12.content: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

욥기 36:13.content: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

욥기 36:14.content: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

욥기 36:15.content: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

욥기 36:16.content: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

욥기 36:17.content: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

욥기 36:18.content: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

욥기 36:19.content: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

욥기 36:20.content: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

욥기 36:21.content: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

욥기 36:22.content: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

욥기 36:23.content: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

욥기 36:24.content: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

욥기 36:25.content: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

욥기 36:26.content: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

욥기 36:27.content: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

욥기 36:28.content: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

욥기 36:29.content: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

욥기 36:30.content: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

욥기 36:31.content: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

욥기 36:32.content: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

욥기 36:33.content: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
